conventions.frame_order: left->right, top->bottom; frame i: col = i % cols, row = floor(i / cols)
conventions.uv: WebP via TextureLoader (flipY=true) and KTX2 (encoded with --lower_left_maps_to_s0t0, KTX2Loader flipY=false) use the SAME UV math: uv = (vUv + vec2(col, rows - 1 - row)) / vec2(cols, rows)  (fx_explosao_5x5: cells start at the top-left and do not fill the sheet, so use c = cell_uv: uv = vec2((vUv.x + col) * c, 1.0 - (row + 1.0 - vUv.y) * c))
conventions.tiers: pc = desktop (<=1024 per flipbook, decal atlas 2048); celular = phone (512, decal atlas 1024); baixa = ?q=baixa, 4x4 grid of 256 px (16 frames) for every animated flipbook
conventions.ktx2: UASTC + Zstd, mipmaps, KTX2Loader with transcoder at public/basis/ (configurarKTX2 in perf.js). Prefer KTX2 on phones (GPU memory ~1 byte/px instead of 4)
conventions.frame_aspect: width/height of the original frame when it was re-packed into square cells: scale the quad to (aspect, 1)
conventions.premultiplied: colour already multiplied by alpha. Do not let three.js premultiply again (texture.premultiplyAlpha = false)
